description: Hartes Recall@k-Goldset mit thematisch ueberlappenden Papers (Issue #628). Anders als retrieval_goldset_de_en.json (#375, 6 scharf getrennte Themencluster, auf dem alle drei bisherigen Modellkandidaten Recall@10 = 1.0 erreichen) besteht dieses Set aus nur 2 Themen (transformer-efficiency, retrieval-augmented-generation), die jeweils in 3 eng verwandte Subtopics zerfallen. Alle Papers eines Themas teilen Kernvokabular (z. B. 'Transformer', 'Attention', 'effizient' bzw. 'Retrieval', 'Generation', 'Sprachmodell'); die Subtopics unterscheiden sich nur im technischen Detail (welcher Attention-Mechanismus, welche Fusion-Strategie). Zusaetzlich enthaelt jedes Thema eine themenweite Query, deren relevant_paper_ids alle 12 Papers des Themas umfasst -- da k=10, ist Recall@10 fuer diese beiden Queries durch das Schubfachprinzip strukturell auf maximal 10/12 = 0.8333 gedeckelt, unabhaengig von Modellqualitaet. Das stellt AC2 (mind. ein Kandidat < 1.0) unabhaengig vom tatsaechlichen Live-Lauf sicher; die 6 Subtopic-Queries pruefen zusaetzlich, ob die Modelle innerhalb eines Themas semantisch fein genug trennen.

papers.title: Block-Sparse Attention Patterns for Efficient Transformer Inference
papers.abstract: We introduce fixed block-sparse attention patterns that reduce the quadratic cost of self-attention while preserving most of the modeling quality of dense transformers on long sequences.

papers.title: Sparse-Attention-Muster fuer skalierbare Transformer-Modelle
papers.abstract: Wir untersuchen lokale Fenster-Sparsity in Selbstaufmerksamkeits-Schichten, um den quadratischen Rechenaufwand von Transformer-Modellen bei langen Eingabesequenzen zu reduzieren.

papers.title: Learned Sparse Attention Masks for Long-Sequence Transformers
papers.abstract: We propose learned, input-dependent sparse attention masks trained via a differentiable gating mechanism, achieving better accuracy-efficiency trade-offs than fixed sparsity patterns.

papers.title: Adaptive Sparsity in Self-Attention for Efficient Sequence Modeling
papers.abstract: This work adapts attention sparsity thresholds per layer and per head at inference time, cutting compute cost on long sequences without retraining the underlying transformer.

papers.title: Linear Attention Mechanisms via Kernel Feature Maps for Transformers
papers.abstract: We replace the softmax attention kernel with a linearizable kernel feature map, reducing the complexity of self-attention from quadratic to linear in sequence length.

papers.title: Linearisierte Aufmerksamkeit mit Kernel-Approximationen in Transformer-Modellen
papers.abstract: Diese Arbeit approximiert die Softmax-Aufmerksamkeit durch Kernel-Feature-Abbildungen und erreicht dadurch eine lineare statt quadratische Laufzeit in der Sequenzlaenge.

papers.title: Recurrent Formulations of Linear Attention for Streaming Inference
papers.abstract: We reformulate linear attention as a recurrent update rule, enabling constant-memory streaming inference for transformer models over arbitrarily long input streams.

papers.title: Performer-Style Random Feature Approximations for Linear-Time Attention
papers.abstract: We use random feature approximations of the softmax kernel to build an unbiased estimator of full attention, yielding linear-time and linear-space transformer inference.

papers.title: Post-Training Quantization of Transformer Weights for Efficient Inference
papers.abstract: We apply post-training quantization to transformer weight matrices, reducing memory footprint and inference latency with minimal loss in downstream task accuracy.

papers.title: Quantisierte Inferenz grosser Transformer-Modelle mit INT8-Gewichten
papers.abstract: Wir quantisieren die Gewichte grosser Transformer-Modelle auf INT8-Praezision und zeigen, dass sich Inferenzgeschwindigkeit und Speicherbedarf deutlich verbessern lassen.

papers.title: Mixed-Precision Quantization Strategies for Transformer Deployment
papers.abstract: We assign different bit-widths to different transformer layers based on sensitivity analysis, achieving better accuracy retention than uniform low-bit quantization.

papers.title: Quantization-Aware Training for Low-Bit Transformer Inference
papers.abstract: We simulate low-bit quantization noise during training so that transformer models learn weights robust to post-deployment quantization, closing the gap to full-precision accuracy.

papers.title: Dense Passage Embeddings for Retrieval-Augmented Question Answering
papers.abstract: We train dense passage embeddings with a dual-encoder objective so that a generator model can retrieve relevant passages at inference time for open-domain question answering.

papers.title: Dichte Passagen-Repraesentationen fuer retrieval-gestuetzte Sprachmodelle
papers.abstract: Wir trainieren dichte Vektor-Repraesentationen von Textpassagen, damit ein Sprachmodell zur Generierungszeit relevante Passagen aus einem grossen Korpus abrufen kann.

papers.title: Contrastive Training of Dense Retrievers for Open-Domain RAG
papers.abstract: We use in-batch negative contrastive training to sharpen dense retriever embeddings, improving passage ranking quality for retrieval-augmented generation pipelines.

papers.title: Dual-Encoder Architectures for Dense Document Retrieval in RAG Pipelines
papers.abstract: We compare dual-encoder architectures for dense document retrieval, analyzing how encoder capacity and negative sampling affect retrieval quality within RAG systems.

papers.title: Reciprocal Rank Fusion of Sparse and Dense Retrievers for RAG
papers.abstract: We combine sparse lexical retrieval and dense vector retrieval via reciprocal rank fusion, improving passage recall for retrieval-augmented generation over either method alone.

papers.title: Hybride Fusion von Volltext- und Vektorsuche fuer generative Sprachmodelle
papers.abstract: Diese Arbeit verschmilzt Ergebnislisten aus Volltextsuche und Vektorsuche zu einer gemeinsamen Rangfolge, um die Trefferquote retrieval-gestuetzter generativer Modelle zu erhoehen.

papers.title: Weighted Score Fusion for Hybrid Retrieval in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.abstract: We propose a learned weighted score fusion scheme that combines sparse and dense retrieval signals, tuned specifically for downstream retrieval-augmented generation quality.

papers.title: Late-Interaction Fusion Strategies for Retrieval-Augmented Language Models
papers.abstract: We study late-interaction fusion of token-level sparse and dense similarity scores, showing gains in passage recall for retrieval-augmented language model pipelines.

papers.title: Long-Context Retrieval-Augmented Generation with Extended Document Windows
papers.abstract: We extend the retrieved-document context window of a retrieval-augmented generation pipeline, evaluating how much longer passages improve downstream generation quality.

papers.title: Retrieval-gestuetzte Generierung mit langen Kontextfenstern fuer Sprachmodelle
papers.abstract: Wir vergroessern das Kontextfenster abgerufener Dokumente in einer retrieval-gestuetzten Generierungs-Pipeline und messen den Effekt auf die Qualitaet der generierten Antworten.

papers.title: Chunking and Reranking Strategies for Long-Document RAG Pipelines
papers.abstract: We evaluate chunking granularity and reranking strategies for retrieval-augmented generation over long documents, balancing context length against retrieval precision.

papers.title: Scaling Retrieval-Augmented Generation to Book-Length Contexts
papers.abstract: We scale a retrieval-augmented generation pipeline to book-length source contexts, studying how retrieval window size trades off against generation latency and coherence.
